Arkady Godlin Although "decoupling" religion from state is a very utopian and ideal goal, it would mean the end of the Jewish people. Because very quickly the muslim population would grow exponentially, outnumber us, and eventually - we'd be exterminatable like we were in Europe. 

Having said that, I did spend the past 50 years feeling that utopia as I was born in NYC. But - alas - the tides have turned - and I came here because I felt unsafe as a Jewish person in America so long as I believed in Israel, as did my children.
